title: Net Purchase Volume Bands Used in Northgate Card Credit Line Reviews
content:
The purchase-volume line addition in the review of a requested credit line increase on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account follows the account's net purchases over the last 12 months, being the purchases less the merchant credits and the dispute credits posted in that time:

- net purchases of 6,000 dollars (6000.00) or more add 300 dollars;
- net purchases of 2,500 dollars (2500.00) or more but below 6,000 dollars add 150 dollars;
- lower net purchases add nothing.

**What is counted.** A total over the last 12 months takes the entries dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the review date. Purchases are the purchase postings only, never cash advances. Merchant credits are the merchant credits and refunds posted to the account, and dispute credits are the provisional and final dispute credits posted to it.

| Net purchases in the last 12 months | Purchase-volume line addition |
|---|---|
| 6000.00 or more | 300.00 |
| 2500.00 up to 5999.99 | 150.00 |
| below 2500.00 | nothing |

**Hypothetical worked case.** Purchase postings of 7210.00 and a cash advance of 400.00 in the last 12 months, with merchant credits of 980.00 and a dispute credit of 250.00 in that time: net purchases are 7210.00 less 980.00 less 250.00, that is 5980.00 (the cash advance is not counted), which is below 6000.00 and at least 2500.00, so the addition is 150.00.
